items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: had an old man called Kaiser, John Joseph's brother, Willie Joseph, also in the band

ctx.x: A real one, December 15, 1961. We're recording today at French Market Fisherman Supplies, 813 Decatur Street. What's your name? Paul Crawford. And mine's Dick Allen. We're waiting on Albert Artighe. He's talking to young Louis Armstrong downstairs, a trumpet player who happens to have the same name as the original Louis Armstrong. While it's fresh in my mind, I thought I'd add that young Louis Armstrong says he's some sort of little off cousin to the original Louis Armstrong. Says that when he first got started,…
